guesses.reason: Short, dense black coat with a crisp white blaze, muzzle, chest bib, and white-tipped paws is the classic tuxedo bicolor pattern on a typical moggy build.
Sturdy, medium-boned body and rounded face with full cheeks loosely resemble American Shorthair structure.
Fairly large, tall, upright ears hint at a slight Oriental influence, though the face and body are otherwise typical domestic.

breed.appearance: Miller is a medium-sized, solidly built tuxedo cat with a glossy short black coat, a white inverted-V blaze running up between the eyes, a white muzzle, chin, and chest bib, and small white 'mitten' tips on the front toes. He has large, upright black ears with slightly pointed tips, greenish-yellow (chartreuse) eyes with a calm, half-lidded expression, a bright pink nose, and long, abundant white whiskers fanning out from his white muzzle. He is shown lying loaf-style with front paws extended forward on a pale gray towel.
breed.fun_fact: Tuxedo cats always come dressed for the occasion, and legend says they have a knack for charming everyone they meet!
